name: agent-wiki
description:
agent-wiki gives your team one shared source of project memory that everyone's AI assistant can read, search, and update. Create a workspace for your agency or consultancy, then a focused wiki for each client or project — decisions, plans, brand and voice guides, meeting notes, and open questions live in clean files instead of one person's chat history.

Connect Claude once and every project you can access comes with it. Ask for a brief and your assistant pulls the latest context; finish a call and it writes the decisions back to the right file. The next teammate — or the next chat — starts with the current picture instead of an archaeology dig through Slack and old threads.

Built for small agency, consulting, and campaign teams where context changes fast and lives in too many places:

- One workspace per team, one wiki per client or project.
- Invite teammates with a link, with owner, admin, and member roles.
- Wikis are private by default and can be restricted to specific people.
- Every read and write is logged, with full version history and one-click revert.
- Sign in with Google; revoke any assistant's access anytime.

agent-wiki works with Claude and any other MCP-connected assistant, so your team is never tied to one tool. And because every page is plain markdown, you can export a whole wiki as .md files that open in any editor — no lock-in, ever.

Start free with one wiki, and upgrade when it becomes part of how the team works.

_published_faq.name: How do I add agent-wiki to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add agent-wiki to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://getagentwiki.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the agent-wiki MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: agent-wiki provides these MCP tools: append_to_inbox, get_wiki_guidance, list_files, list_wikis, maintain_wiki, read_file, search_files, setup_wiki, and write_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to agent-wiki?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to agent-wiki in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
agent-wiki requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
agent-wiki is developed by animal, ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
